symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() in harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py copied w:t text as it stands, so a character typed in the Symbol font stayed as its private-use code point and displays as an empty box. This compilation has one: U+F0B4 (the multiplication sign) in s 159ZRD(1). It sets no character as a Word <w:sym> element. cth_convert_sym.py maps Symbol-font characters and private-use code points U+F0xx to their Unicode characters (· × − • ≤ ≥ ° ′ — ÷ ±) and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]".
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: 1 line, nothing else: line 9972, s 159ZRD(1) "Arrears amount × Average tax rate on recent arrears" (was U+F0B4 in place of ×). Line numbers are unchanged, so the formulas sidecar's line references still hold.
